name: Mad Dog
source:
Leader of the gang hired by Prince to raid Shing's casino.
He is small in stature, but has long arms and legs and is an extremely skilled fighter.
Originally from Indonesia, Prince once saved his life when he first arrived in Macau, and he feels indebted to him for that, so he works as Prince's pawn.
